findings: Q1602.4 now joins Q1601.4, U1601.6, D1602.1 and R1601.1 in one ACT_GATE group.
C1003 moves left 0.15 mm and R303 up 0.35 mm without rotation; their owner guards follow the explicit plan.
A former clamp via is explicitly reassigned and moved to gate (37.2,7.3); a new clamp via is at (36.54,7.55). No ground via moves.
The front gate approach uses one outward escape and deliberate bends to avoid source copper and the actual merged reference-plane void. No new same-face nominal body hit remains.
The inner clamp detour preserves filled 3V3 corridors and reference ground; native fill minimum thickness matters in addition to trace clearance.
WDI uses a single direct pad-centre segment; the tiny rounded-pad/body intersection in candidate D is eliminated.
All original connections, 50 power-width, 155 ground-pad and 63 adjacency screens remain valid. Six historical transition flags remain.

projection_review.review: The rerouted inner clamp branch projects below the slightly translated back-face bypass capacitor. Intervening In4 ground and the short restored 3V3 feed were checked; all 50 power-width screens and capacitor ground connectivity remain intact. Actual supply noise and temperature remain unqualified.
projection_review.coupling_and_thermal: NOT_TESTED; local geometry reviewed, full engineering qualification remains open.

projection_review.review: WDI leaves the unchanged front-mounted through-hole header on the back face and runs directly between actual pad centres. Intervening ground and native hole/land clearances were checked; the header and mating geometry were not moved or qualified.
projection_review.coupling_and_thermal: NOT_TESTED; local geometry reviewed, full engineering qualification remains open.

projection_review.review: Back gate copper and the inner clamp branch project opposite the fixed front power MOSFET. Existing source/drain copper is preserved and In1/In4 ground geometry was inspected. A ground-reference screen is not high-side GATE-to-SOURCE switching-loop or thermal qualification.
projection_review.coupling_and_thermal: NOT_TESTED; local geometry reviewed, full engineering qualification remains open.
